placements.title: Structured Checklists Standardize Onboarding Workflows Over Legacy Documentation
placements.frame: How do structured first-week checklists establish standard operational onboarding over legacy documentation?
placements.why: Wren Duskfield outlines the mandatory first-week requirements of the Pallasine checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) and highlights the formal transition from legacy wiki onboarding documentation.
